title: Symmetry-aware super-resolution of crystal orientation maps via invariant latent-space learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.10898v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Crystal-orientation maps are physical fields defined only up to crystal symmetry; electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) resolves them experimentally, but acquisition-time constraints limit spatial resolution. Unlike conventional images, EBSD data lie on the quotient space $\mathrm{SO}(3)/G$, where $G$ is the crystal-symmetry group. Standard Euclidean interpolation can therefore mix symmetry-equivalent representations and blur grain boundaries. We introduce the Symmetry-Group-Aware Super-Resolution Attention Network (SG-SRAN), which incorporates crystal symmetry and boundary preservation by design. A frozen, locally isometric encoder maps equivalent orientations to a common latent representation in which Euclidean distance approximates misorientation. Super-resolution is performed in this space, with each high-resolution token restricted to a feature-consistent local support to prevent cross-boundary mixing. A dictionary-based decoder

translated_title: 通过不变潜空间学习实现对称性感知的晶体取向图超分辨率
translated_abstract: 晶体取向图是仅在晶体对称性意义下定义的物理场；电子背散射衍射（EBSD）可以在实验上解析这些取向图，但采集时间的限制制约了空间分辨率。与传统图像不同，EBSD 数据位于商空间 SO(3)/G 上，其中 G 为晶体对称群。因此，标准的欧几里得插值方法可能会混淆对称等价的表示，并使晶界变得模糊。我们提出了对称群感知超分辨率注意力网络（SG-SRAN），该方法在设计上就融入了晶体对称性与晶界保持机制。一个冻结的、局部等距的编码器将等价取向映射到一个共同的潜在表示空间，在该空间中欧几里得距离可近似于取向差。超分辨率重建在该潜空间中进行，每个高分辨率 token 都被限制在特征一致的局部支撑域内，以防止跨晶界的特征混合。基于字典的解码器……
tldr: 该论文提出对称群感知超分辨率注意力网络SG-SRAN，通过将晶体取向映射到对称不变且局部等距的潜空间中进行超分辨率重建，从设计上实现了晶体对称性感知与晶界保持，避免了传统欧氏方法混淆对称等价表示和模糊晶界的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes SG-SRAN, a Symmetry-Group-Aware Super-Resolution Attention Network that performs super-resolution in a symmetry-invariant, locally isometric latent space where equivalent orientations share a common representation, achieving crystal-symmetry awareness and grain-boundary preservation by design.
